name: Ferrellgas / Blue Rhino
desc:
Accounts Payable Assistant | $18-$23/hr | Data Entry Heavy
1. Company: Ferrellgas
Industry: Energy / Propane Supply, Accounting & Finance
What Your Day Will Look Like: You'd be processing vendor invoices day in and day out, checking the details, entering the data accurately into Ferrellgas's financial systems, and researching any discrepancies that pop up. You'd also be a go-to resource for other employees who have questions about AP policies, whether that's an invoice, an expense report, petty cash, a customer refund, or a purchasing card charge. Beyond invoice processing, you'd handle vendor correspondence by phone and email, compile reports in Excel and Smartsheet, and help prepare documentation for annual audits. It's detail-heavy behind-the-scenes finance work that keeps the whole payment process running smoothly.
assessment: Expect a basic assessment, a typing test, and a home internet speed test, since the posting doesn't state otherwise.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Not stated outright. Associate's degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
Required Experience: 2+ years of Accounts Payable or Finance experience, including invoice processing.
Preferred Experience: Cognos, PeopleSoft, or Smartsheet experience is a plus.
Required Skills:
Intermediate or higher Excel skills
Strong computer skills with the ability to learn new systems quickly
Customer service experience
Strong attention to detail and a problem-solving mindset
Strong interpersonal skills and a team-first attitude
Ability to work effectively in a remote environment
4. Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
Someone with genuine AP or finance experience who wants to put that background to work remotely
Someone detail-oriented who enjoys catching and resolving discrepancies
Someone comfortable being the go-to resource other employees count on for policy questions
Someone with solid Excel skills ready to compile reports and manage data accurately
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone without at least 2 years of AP or finance experience, since this is required outright, not preferred
Anyone who needs visa sponsorship, since the posting explicitly states this isn't available now or in the future
Anyone uncomfortable with long periods of sitting and daily computer-based work
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Accounts payable processing
Invoice data entry accuracy
Vendor correspondence and discrepancy resolution
Excel and Smartsheet reporting
Expense report and P-card policy support
Audit preparation and documentation
Financial systems proficiency
Attention to detail
Customer service
Remote independent work
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process: 1. Application 2. Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you. 3. If assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen. 4. If phone screen passes you can expect the final interview. Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3-15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your Accounts Payable or finance experience, especially with invoice processing.
How do you research and resolve a discrepancy when an invoice doesn't match what's expected?
What's your comfort level with Excel, and have you used Smartsheet, Cognos, or PeopleSoft before?
Walk us through how you'd help a coworker who's confused about an expense report or P-card policy.
How do you stay accurate and organized processing a high volume of invoices under deadline?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: Not stated in posting. Confirm directly.
Shift: Not detailed in posting. Confirm directly.
Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, accident, and critical illness insurance, company-provided short and long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D, 401(k) with company match, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), FSA and HSA options, PTO, parental leave, tuition reimbursement, a wellness program, Employee Assistance Program, Medicare support, referral program, employee discounts, and propane savings.
Equipment Provided: Not stated in posting. Participant is responsible for reliable, high-speed internet and a dedicated workspace suitable for video calls.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated.
Drug Test: Not stated.
Notes: Ferrellgas is already on your brick-and-mortar partner list under "Ferrellgas/Blue Rhino," this role is explicitly remote though, worth logging as a separate remote opportunity rather than folding into the existing on-site contact. The 2+ years of required AP experience is a real, firm gate, so this isn't an entry-level data entry role, it's better suited to a participant who already has finance or bookkeeping background.
Career Pathway: Not stated directly in posting. Reasonable inferred path: Accounts Payable Assistant → Senior AP Specialist → AP Team Lead → Accounts Payable Manager, though this is an estimate, not confirmed by Ferrellgas directly.
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
